Frontier-Style Family Fun
Join the Pioneer Hall Players for 2 hours of rousing dancing, singing and zany comedy.

Get ready to clap, move your feet, sing along or just have a good time at rustic Pioneer Hall in Disney’s Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground. In between skits and song standards, chow down on all-you-care-to-enjoy fried chicken and smoked BBQ pork ribs, as well as a tossed green salad, cowboy beans, fresh-baked cornbread, macaroni-and-cheese and creamy coleslaw. And be sure to save room for the grand finale… strawberry shortcake!

Unlimited draft beer, wine and sangria are available for Guests 21 years of age and older (proper ID required). Soft drinks are also included.

View the full Hoop-Dee-Doo Musical Revue menu now.

Getting to the Show
Please arrive 30 minutes prior to reservation time to check in. The doors open at 4:00 PM, 6:15 PM or 8:30 PM. Seating will begin immediately at these times; the show begins 20 minutes later.

Using Disney Resort Transportation
Please allow sufficient travel and transfer time, as there is no direct route between your Disney Resort hotel and Disney’s Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground.

Using Your Own Vehicle
Please park at the entrance to Disney’s Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground or—during major holiday periods—at a nearby satellite lot. Please allow an additional 30 minutes for bus transportation from your parking location to the event.

Taking the Ferry from Magic Kingdom Park
Allow up to one hour and 30 minutes travel time.

Using Minnie Van Service
Request a ride with this whimsical personal ride service and get dropped off at Pioneer Hall. Use the Lyft app to see the total cost and pay for the service.

Modifications
This experience does not allow modifications once the reservation is confirmed. Learn More

Prices

Choose from 3 different seating categories based on the chart below. Wheelchair-accessible seating is located in Category 1. Category 2 is located on both the main floor—which has limited wheelchair-accessible seating—and on the second floor, which has no elevator access or wheelchair-accessible seating. Category 3 is located on the second floor with no elevator access or wheelchair-accessible seating. Applicable table-service meals will be redeemed from the dining plan for each person dining. Prices include tax and gratuity.

  • Category 1 – $78 (ages 10 and older); $45 (ages 3 to 9)
  • Category 2 – $74 (ages 10 and older); $41 (ages 3 to 9)
  • Category 3 – $70 (ages 10 and older); $40 (ages 3 to 9)

Prices and show times are subject to change without notice.

Know Before You Go

Reservations
Advance reservations are highly recommended. Learn when advance reservations can be made.

Same-day reservations can be made on a limited basis and are subject to availability.

Add a Cake Order to Your Reservation
Preorder a delicious surprise to make an upcoming celebration at this location extra special. Learn how to order your cake now.

Prepayment Required
Prepayment is required. Cancellations may result in charges if made with insufficient notice. Specific policies will be detailed at the time of reservation booking.

Food and Special Dietary Requests
Please include any special dietary requests on the Review Your Reservation screen when you book online. When checking in for your reservation, you will be directed to speak with a Special Diets Trained Cast Member before entering Pioneer Hall.

Dining Plan
When using the Disney Dining Plan at this location, 2 Table-Service meals will be redeemed from the dining plan for each person dining.

Seating
Seats are allocated based on party size and category.

Wheelchair-accessible seating is located in Category 1, with some additional wheelchair-accessible seating in Category 2 on the main floor. Category 3 and some Category 2 seating is located on the second floor, which has no elevator access or wheelchair-accessible seating.

Checking In

Please check in at the check-in booth upon arrival at Pioneer Hall.

Alcoholic Beverages
Guests must be 21 years of age or older to consume alcoholic beverages. A valid form of government identification will be required to verify your age.

Weather Permitting
This show may be cancelled due to severe or inclement weather
